criterion_4_annotation_set.rule: §10.4's fourth criterion needs only enough paired items to separate the surviving conditions. selection.note: agreement with the deterministic VERIFIER is reported for every condition but is not a selection criterion: §10.4's fourth criterion is agreement with HUMAN labels. Selecting the judge that best matches the verifier would make the held-out evaluation circular.
selection.reading_note: criterion 2 says 'absence of PROBLEMATIC truncation' and criterion 3 'VALID parsing and coverage'. Those are threshold words and no threshold is registered. The ranking reading takes the best value at each criterion; the threshold reading eliminates only what is distinguishably worse at 95%. Both are reported because they do not agree on whether criterion 4 is reached.
